title: Authenticate the writerless SD/NFS commissioning boot path
author: root/coordinator

checks.description: The default diagnostic remains writer-free; only explicit commissioning composition embeds the target writer and policy in content protected by the SD-resident verified-initrd hash chain.

The trusted initramfs executes the embedded writer before switching to network-root code, mounts NFS read-only only as the exact image source, and passes bounded commissioning and claim-port parameters.
A local explicit host controller prepares a short-lived exact-image job and durable one-shot claim, signs only after durable consumption, and fails closed without automatic retry or rearm.

Synthetic QEMU passes end-to-end success, source/identity/job/claim refusal, replay/lost acknowledgement, interruption, flush/readback faults and unchanged diagnostic checks using disposable media only.

Strict builds, focused tests and hash-bound evidence pass; documentation explicitly excludes SoC secure boot, live CID/dev_t, physical write/power-loss behavior and release qualification. H12 remains the only physical gate.
